title: Template Studio
description: A document workspace with rich-text editing, template variables, desktop/mobile previews, browser-local drafts, and sanitized HTML export.

descriptions.en: A document workspace with rich-text editing, template variables, desktop/mobile previews, browser-local drafts, and sanitized HTML export.
descriptions.de: Ein Dokumenten-Workspace mit Rich-Text-Editor, Vorlagenvariablen, Desktop-/Mobilvorschau, lokalen Entwürfen und bereinigtem HTML-Export.
descriptions.id: Ruang kerja dokumen dengan editor rich text, variabel templat, pratinjau desktop/seluler, draf lokal browser, dan ekspor HTML tersanitasi.

title: Cineflix Web Component
description: A film discovery app with a curated collection, live TMDB title search, genre filters, sorting, a saved watchlist, and film details.

descriptions.en: A film discovery app with a curated collection, live TMDB title search, genre filters, sorting, a saved watchlist, and film details.
descriptions.de: Eine Film-App mit kuratierter Sammlung, Live-Titelsuche über TMDB, Genrefiltern, Sortierung, gespeicherter Merkliste und Filmdetails.
descriptions.id: Aplikasi penemuan film dengan koleksi kurasi, pencarian judul langsung melalui TMDB, filter genre, pengurutan, daftar tontonan tersimpan, dan detail film.

title: Atmos — Weather App
description: A weather dashboard with city-local forecasts, city search, saved places, temperature units, light/dark themes, share links, and timestamped offline forecasts.

descriptions.en: A weather dashboard with city-local forecasts, city search, saved places, temperature units, light/dark themes, share links, and timestamped offline forecasts.
descriptions.de: Ein Wetter-Dashboard mit ortsbezogenen Vorhersagen, Städtesuche, gespeicherten Orten, Temperatureinheiten, hellem/dunklem Design, teilbaren Links und Offline-Vorhersagen mit Zeitstempel.
descriptions.id: Dasbor cuaca dengan prakiraan waktu setempat, pencarian kota, tempat tersimpan, satuan suhu, tema terang/gelap, tautan berbagi, dan prakiraan luring bertanda waktu.
